newsitem.title: USA: Zila oral cancer product ok'd in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Zila oral cancer product ok'd in Hungary.

text.p: Zila Inc said Monday that its oral cancer detection system has been approved for sale in Hungary, giving Zila its first Eastern European market.
The company said it is finalizing a distribution agreement with a Hungarian dental products distributor and expects to make the first shipment in January, with sales beginning immediately thereafter.
Zila said sales of its product, OraTest, are expected to begin in Poland in the spring. Bermuda has already approved OraTest, and India has placed a firm order for the product, the company said.
Zila, which markets oral healthcare products, said OraTest is in use in Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia. The company said United States Food and Drug Administration approval is pending.
